Could you please provide any dua to get the missed laptop. it is very serious.my name will be spoiled. because iam the computer incharge person. Please look into the matter. Answer ID: 4994 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 533/513=L/1429) You should recite: انا للہ وانا الیہ راجعون . O ccasionally perform two rakat salah with the intention of Salatul Haajah and supplicate Allah, in-sha-Allah the missing thing will be recovered. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
